title: start_spec prompt template is inaccessible via moeb tools
description: The spec prompt template is saved to an absolute path in the user's Claude project folder (outside the working directory). moeb tools only accept working-directory-relative paths, so reading the template requires a Claude Code native Read tool. This causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every moeb spec invocation.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_spec to inject the full prompt template content directly into the MCP tool response, or expose it via a dedicated read_spec_prompt moeb tool that returns the content without requiring a file path.
